name: duopore-public-achievement-quantity-worksheet
description: Turn measured before-and-after results into clear numbers you can use in a CV.

interface.longDescription: Turn measured before-and-after results into clear numbers you can use in a CV. Enter your own starting and ending amounts. See the change and a percent where one can be worked out, plus a sentence based on those figures. For adults using their own facts. It does not invent achievements, claim you caused the change or label every increase as good.
defaultPrompt: Turn these measured work results into a factual CV sentence.
Calculate the change between my before-and-after figures.

positive.prompt: Use Achievement Quantity Worksheet with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"items":[{"id":"E1","action":"Revised the reporting checklist","scope":"course team","unit":"minutes per report","baseline":50,"after":35,"start":"2026-09-01","end":"2026-09-30","source":"Timed practice log"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 measured statements prepared without adding outcomes.","rows":[{"id":"E1","baseline":50,"after":35,"unit":"minutes per report","signedChange":-15,"signedPercentChange":-30,"source":"Timed practice log","factSentence":"Revised the reporting checklist for course team. Recorded minutes per report: 50 before and 35 after, 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30."}],"warnings":["A before/after difference alone does not establish that the action caused the change. A zero baseline has no meaningful percentage change."]}
